# matterbridge_settings (Resource)

The Matterbridge settings, as on the settings page of the frontend. The resource manages only the attributes that you set. The other attributes show the current values. If a change needs a restart, the apply restarts Matterbridge, and the plan shows a warning. During the restart, HomeKit and other controllers lose the devices for some time. If you destroy the resource, the settings do not change.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "matterbridge_settings" "this" {
  bridge_mode  = "bridge"
  matter_port  = 5540
  virtual_mode = "outlet"
  mb_log_level = "info"

  # The frontend password. It is write-only: change password_wo_version to set it again.
  password_wo         = var.matterbridge_password
  password_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `bridge_mode` (String) bridge (one Matter node for all devices) or childbridge (one node for each plugin). A change restarts Matterbridge.
- `ipv4_address` (String) The IPv4 address that Matter uses. "" means all addresses. A change restarts Matterbridge.
- `ipv6_address` (String) The IPv6 address that Matter uses. "" means all addresses. A change restarts Matterbridge.
- `matter_discriminator` (Number) The commissioning discriminator, 0–4095. A change restarts Matterbridge.
- `matter_passcode` (Number) The commissioning passcode, 1–99999998. A change restarts Matterbridge.
- `matter_port` (Number) The Matter port, 5540–5600. A change restarts Matterbridge.
- `mb_log_file` (Boolean) If true, Matterbridge also logs to a file.
- `mb_log_level` (String) The Matterbridge log level: debug, info, notice, warn, error or fatal.
- `mdns_interface` (String) The network interface for mDNS. "" means all interfaces. A change restarts Matterbridge.
- `mj_log_file` (Boolean) If true, matter.js also logs to a file.
- `mj_log_level` (String) The matter.js log level: debug, info, notice, warn, error or fatal.
- `password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The frontend password. It is write-only, so it is not in the plan or the state. The provider sets it when password_wo_version changes. "" removes the password. After the change, the provider uses the new password.
- `password_wo_version` (String) Change this value to set password_wo again. The provider cannot read the password, so it cannot see a difference.
- `virtual_mode` (String) The virtual devices of Matterbridge (restart, update and so on): disabled, light, outlet, switch or mounted_switch. A change restarts Matterbridge.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The value is always "matterbridge".
- `matterbridge_version` (String) The Matterbridge version. The Home Assistant add-on (or the image) controls it.
- `restart_required` (Boolean) True if Matterbridge has changes that apply only after a restart.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import matterbridge_settings.this matterbridge
```
